# The Chess Herald

> The Chess Herald (https://chessherald.com) is a curated chess news site.
> Each day it picks a handful of the most newsworthy chess stories and
> publishes an original analysis piece on each, linking to the original
> source rather than rewording it. Articles are AI-drafted (credited to the
> house byline "Claude Henry") and reviewed by a human editor before
> publishing.

## Key facts

- Sources: FIDE, Chess.com and ChessBase news, plus Chess Tournament
  Calendar's own tournament database for monthly regional round-ups.
- Every article names and links its original source, both inline and at
  the end of the piece.
- Each article is written through one lens: Results, People (interviews
  and profiles), History (a specific historical parallel), Money (prize
  funds, sponsors, deals), Controversy (disputes, cheating cases,
  politics) or OTB Tournaments (data-driven regional tournament round-ups).
- Photos are correctly licensed images from Wikimedia Commons with visible
  credit and a link to the original file.
- How the site works, including its use of AI: https://chessherald.com/about/

## Sections

- [Homepage](https://chessherald.com/): the latest articles.
- [All articles](https://chessherald.com/archive/): every article, newest first.
- [Weekly recaps](https://chessherald.com/recaps/): the week's biggest stories.
- [Results](https://chessherald.com/lens/results/)
- [FIDE rankings, open top 100](https://chessherald.com/rankings/): updated monthly from FIDE's official standard rating list.
- [FIDE rankings, women's top 25](https://chessherald.com/rankings/women/)
- [Players](https://chessherald.com/players/): profiles of every ranked player, with career highlights and our coverage of each.
- [Events](https://chessherald.com/events/): the major events of the chess year, with history, past winners and upcoming dates.
- [People](https://chessherald.com/lens/people/)
- [History](https://chessherald.com/lens/history/)
- [Money](https://chessherald.com/lens/money/)
- [Controversy](https://chessherald.com/lens/controversy/)
- [OTB Tournaments](https://chessherald.com/lens/otb-tournaments/)
- Regions: [Europe](https://chessherald.com/continent/europe/), [Asia](https://chessherald.com/continent/asia/), [North America](https://chessherald.com/continent/north-america/), [South America](https://chessherald.com/continent/south-america/), [Africa](https://chessherald.com/continent/africa/), [Oceania](https://chessherald.com/continent/oceania/), [Global](https://chessherald.com/continent/global/)
- [RSS feed](https://chessherald.com/rss.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://chessherald.com/sitemap-index.xml)

## Reuse

Article text may be quoted with attribution to The Chess Herald and a link
to the specific article. Each linked source article keeps its own outlet's
rights, separate from The Chess Herald's analysis.
